ownership: Combat/Spell execution constructs and commits movement requests; Room/World owners validate destinations and perform movement; Combat owns action/threat/combat cleanup; Character/NPC persistence owners save only promoted state.

bidirectional_relationships.spell_to_targets: source spell identifies actor and one or two movement targets
bidirectional_relationships.movement_to_combat: optional combat cleanup and action interruption
bidirectional_relationships.movement_to_status: root and hidden removal are explicit promoted policy
bidirectional_relationships.movement_to_persistence: persistence request is optional and evidence-gated
